title.narrative: Medium-Voltage Sub-Transmission Expansion Sector Project (former name: Rural Electrification Project)

description.narrative: The proposed project will expand the supply of reliable and cost effective grid-electricity in Kampong Thom, Kampong Cham, Siem Reap, Kandal and Banteay Meanchey province in Cambodia. It will (i) expand the electricity transmission infrastructure by constructing 2,110 kilometer (km) of 22 kilovolt (kV) sub-transmission lines , (ii) support the implementation of the project, and (iii) improve the operational effectiveness and efficiency of Electricite du Cambodge.

Output: Component 1: Expanding the medium-voltage sub-transmission network Indicator: By June 2017:
22kV sub-transmission lines expanded by 2,110 cct-km across Kampong Thom, Kampong Cham, Siem Reap, Kandal and Banteay Meanchey Province (2010 baseline: 1,965 cct-km) Progress/Status: Package 1- 100% of civil works completed. Main civil works output includes: installation of 27,448 medium voltage (MV) poles; stringing of 1,897 cct-km of conductor; installation of 36 km of underground cable; installation of 613 transformers; and installation of 252 switchgear. All sub-transmission lines have been tested and handed over to EDC branch offices for operations. Package 2 - 100% of works completed. Total output of civil works: installation of 6,473 poles (100%); stringing of 495 cct-km of conductors (100%); installation of 7.875 km of underground cable; installation of 108 transformers; and installation of 7 switchgear (100%). Completed sub-transmission lines have been tested and handed over to EDC branch offices for operations. Data Source: Annual reports by EDC
